podcast.title: Pacific Northwest Scene (Late 50s/Early 60s)
podcast.body: A significant portion of the music labeled Garage Rock or Frat Rock emerged from the thriving Pacific Northwest music scene in the late 1950s and early 1960s, where mostly white musicians adapted and performed electric guitar versions of music by black artists. "much of the music that gets labeled Gavage Rock or Frat Rock comes from that area."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Pioneered by Joey D and the Starlighters
podcast.body: Joey D and the Starlighters' musical style, described as a stripped-down version of R&B with a dominant organ, was a style that would later be recognized as Frat Rock. "The kind of thing that would later get known as Garage Rock or Frat Rock."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
